title: Insufficient Flow Detected
shortDescription: Flow switch open while heater calls for heat.
fullDescription: FLO indicates the heater pressure/flow switch did not close when the circulation pump started. Common causes are a clogged filter, low water, air lock, or a failed switch.

title: Flow Switch Stuck Closed
shortDescription: Flow switch closed when pump is off.
fullDescription: HFL indicates the flow switch is reading closed when the pump is not running. Heater is locked out for safety.

title: Spa Overheat Lockout
fullDescription: OH indicates water exceeded 108-112F. Spa locks heater, allow cool down.

title: Hi-Limit Tripped
fullDescription: HL indicates hi-limit thermistor at heater detected unsafe temperature.

title: Temperature Sensor A Fault
fullDescription: SnSa indicates the primary water temperature sensor is open or shorted.

title: Hi-Limit Sensor Fault
fullDescription: SnSb indicates fault on hi-limit sensor circuit.

title: Freeze Protection Active
fullDescription: ICE indicates water below 40F; pumps cycle to prevent freeze. Informational.

title: Cool Water Mode
fullDescription: COOL indicates water is significantly below setpoint and heater is running.

title: Topside Panel Communication Lost
fullDescription: COMM indicates the topside control panel lost communication with the main pack. Inspect ribbon cable.

title: Dry-Fire Detected
fullDescription: dr indicates dry-fire condition; heater locked out to prevent element damage.
